connection.reconnectingMessage: Connection lost — the content below may be stale.
connection.stalledMessage: Connected, but no output has arrived for a while.

voice.permissionDeniedBody: Threadbase needs microphone access to dictate prompts. Enable it in Settings.

dialog.cancelMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel this session?
dialog.removeMessage: Are you sure you want to remove this session?
dialog.stopMessage: Stop this session? Claude will be interrupted.
dialog.stopFailed: Couldn't stop the session. Check your connection and try again.

status.stuckBody: The session hasn't reached its prompt yet. You can watch its console output live instead of waiting.

session.notFoundBody: This session is no longer on the server. It may have ended or been cleaned up.
session.endedBody: This session ended without producing any output.
session.noTerminalBody:
This session has no active terminal.
Resume the session to start a new terminal.
session.runningElsewhereBody: This session was started outside the app and is tracked as read-only. Stop it in the other terminal, then come back — the conversation will open here automatically once it finishes.
session.alreadyRunningBody: This session has an active process on the server. Resuming here will stop that process and start a new terminal session in the app.

banner.streamingInfo: Tool calls and output stream here in real time. Type a follow-up below while Claude is still working.
